publication.citation: Martinez MF, Dibbs A, et al. Computationally Modeling the Physiologic Impact of the Ratio of Fats to Carbohydrates in the Diet on Intake Among Metabolically Healthy Adults. Current Developments in Nutrition. 2025;9(7):107487.
publication.validationBoundary: The publication reports physiologic plausibility and food-intake behavior comparisons. This is not a validated measure of subjective hunger in Cy.

equations.glp1: delta_per_min = eating_effect + lower_si_fat_ml * 0.2 + large_intestine_fat_ml * 0.2 + lower_si_carbohydrate_ml * 0.2 - glp1_pM * 0.06
equations.ghrelin: delta_per_min = stomach_fat_ml * -0.01 + upper_si_fat_ml * -0.005 + stomach_carbohydrate_ml * -0.01 + upper_si_carbohydrate_ml * -0.005 + (110 - ghrelin_pM) * 0.04
equations.satiety: gastric_coefficient * gastric_distention_ml + 1.2 * CCK + 0.08 * PYY * 0.2 * GLP1 + 0.02 * (110 - ghrelin)
equations.reportedSatietyScore: bound the raw equation result to the publication's stated 1-to-10 satiety-score domain; retain the unbounded equation result in the inspection trace
equations.gastricCoefficient: 0 when distention <= 296 mL; 0.0025 when 296 < distention < 500 mL; 0.0035 when distention >= 500 mL

parameters.name: fat_energy_density_kcal_per_g
parameters.derivation: Conventional metabolizable-energy conversion needed to turn the publication's energy fractions into grams before applying its published g/mL density range; it is not a fitted satiety parameter.

parameters.name: carbohydrate_energy_density_kcal_per_g
parameters.derivation: Conventional metabolizable-energy conversion needed to turn the publication's energy fractions into grams before applying its published g/mL density range; it is not a fitted satiety parameter.

parameters.provenanceClass: PUBLISHED LITERATURE AND CALIBRATED MODEL PARAMETER

parameters.name: satiety_score_domain
parameters.sourceStatement: The publication states that satiety is measured on a score from 1 to 10.

dietaryInput.source: HMPPS Food in Prisons Policy Framework Guidance Manual, current England and Wales guidance
dietaryInput.snackPolicy: No snack is generated or assumed unless a snack event exists in Cy's world.

uncertainty.constraintDerivation: The tested 10%, 20%, and 30% relative-fat cases satisfy both the HMPPS adult-male daily fat maximum and carbohydrate minimum when protein is 16% of 2605 kcal.
uncertainty.reportedValue: minimum and maximum satiety score across every deterministic track

initialisationPolicy.criterion: First FULLY_CONSUMED breakfast or PARTLY_CONSUMED breakfast with an OBSERVED_EXACT portion fraction and no unresolved intake uncertainty at that timestamp.
initialisationPolicy.restartContinuity: An unobserved runner interval changes status to INPUT_INCOMPLETE; no fasting assumption is made.

epistemicLimits.proteinGIHormoneEffects: The publication represents male protein intake but does not explicitly model protein effects on GI transit or hormone release.
